subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Snow was falling light when everyone was leaving church.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the adjective 'light' is incorrect.
 
• The word **'lightly'** should be used instead of **'light'** to describe the manner in which the snow was falling.
 
• Therefore, the correct form is 'lightly'.

Hence, the correct statement is **"*Snow was falling lightly__ when everyone was leaving church*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Adjectives describe nouns and pronouns, while adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, and other adverbs.
 
• In this sentence,** 'lightly' **is the correct adverb to describe how the snow was falling.
